exposure: oral misoprostol as an induction of labour (IOL) agent
outcome: Proportion of women delivering within 24 hours of oral misoprostol administration
Rates of maternal and perinatal severe adverse events
cohort: 209 women with a singleton pregnancy in cephalic presentation and an unfavourable cervix who were undergoing induction of labor
finding: Oral misoprostol was found to be a safe and effective method for induction of labor in a resource-limited setting, with 74% of women delivering within 24 hours and a low rate of severe adverse events.
mod_finding: A significantly higher proportion of babies born to women who underwent caesarean section after failed IOL were admitted to special-care nursery compared to babies delivered vaginally.
